scientific_goal: Discover new ART-like system architectures for later novelty review and wet-lab prioritization, not simply new RT labels.
coordinate_contract: 0-based half-open; original linear clipped neighborhoods, no origin wrapping; edge flags retained
protein_source: Uniform full-genome Prodigal prediction for all 919 genomes. New de novo branch, not audited NCBI official protein annotations. Previous official-protein analyses unchanged.

orf.translation_table: record model-selected table; no forced -g in meta mode
orf.noncanonical_or_empty_protein: HOLD; do not replace, drop, or relabel as negative

rt_scan.profile_snapshot: Reuse byte-frozen RT panel returned by Stage04B-R1D2, including ACC.version and GA values. No network/model update.
rt_scan.primary: hmmsearch --cut_ga; an included domain in RVT_1 or RVT_2 is profile-level RT evidence, not catalytic or ART proof
rt_scan.auxiliary: RVT_3 alone is RT-like auxiliary evidence, not sufficient for the RT_CORE label
rt_scan.deduplication: Exact amino-acid SHA256 for computation only; restore all predicted genomic loci and candidate links.
rt_scan.background: one combined, frozen target universe; no data-dependent database reduction
rt_scan.absence_interpretation: NO_HIT_IN_THIS_PROFILE_PANEL, never RT absent or non-ART
rt_scan.scope: All whole-genome predicted proteins from all 919 genomes plus the six registered references; exact-AA computational dedup then restore every locus

repeat_survey.scope: All 3674 fixed new919 candidate neighborhoods, independent of RT hits and scores
repeat_survey.selection: each exact seed occurrence cluster; deterministic greedy nonoverlap; maximal common exact extension within the core limit
repeat_survey.low_complexity: retain and label; do not promote to high-complexity evidence
repeat_survey.redundancy: merge contained shifted representations with equal copy counts; preserve source-seed multiplicity
repeat_survey.noncoding_label: No overlap with predicted CDS is prediction-relative only; no NCBI official CDS annotation is used or claimed in this stage.
repeat_survey.predicted_orf_overlap: separate predicted-CDS mask; absence of annotation never establishes absence of a gene
repeat_survey.limits: exact-core, direct-repeat, finite-distance survey; not an exhaustive imperfect-repeat finder; no RNA expression or function inferred

approximate_repeat_sensitivity.coverage: Only fixed-length copies sharing an unchanged sampled seed with an actual template; not exhaustive imperfect-array search

recurrence_witness: Reconstruct exact k-mer match starts and merge consecutive overlapping matches into two-copy blocks at each frozen best window/k/lag. Do not call match count a repeat-copy count.
candidate_retention: All 3674 rows and original fields unchanged, including candidates with no RT or repeat hit.
parent_scope: Predicted CDS only; actual repeat copy and full-span CDS overlap reported separately. No proven-noncoding claim.
novelty_status: NOT_ASSESSED. Exact DNA/AA de-duplication is not near-homology or known-ART exclusion.
